id.description: Globally unique identifier for this role.

ifsId.description: IFS system identifier for this Role.

entityType.description: Entity type discriminator. Always "Role" for Role entities.

basedOn.description: Id of the object this object is derived from.

entityDocumentationUrl.description: URL for documentation about this entity.

description.description: Optional human-readable explanation of what this role is for.

memberId.description: Identifier of the member acting through this role.

scopeId.description: Identifier of the scope where this role has authority.

scope.description: Scope entity describing where this role applies.

permissions.description: Permission entities bundled into this role.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this role record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when this role record was last updated.

expiresAt.description: Optional timestamp after which this role no longer applies.
